## /rebar-debug final report — CLOSED (plan_defect, caused_by f449)

**Proven survivor (dynamic, by execution).** Call site: `run_differs.py:237`, `refresh_scoped_snapshot(ctx)` — first executable statement of `run_differs()`, imported locally from `snapshot_lagfree_refresh`. Commented the call out and ran `pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler` → **3636 passed, 1 skipped** (GREEN). The wiring is invisible to every offline test; only the live Jira DC lane exercises the lag-free overlay. Restored to a clean tree.

**Behaviour pinned.** The observable lost when the call is dropped is the *invocation itself* (the lag-free scalar overlay refresh before the differ reads `curr_snapshot`). The new test asserts the CALL HAPPENED once with the same `ctx`, and before the differ — not downstream freshness (which a coincidentally-fresh fixture would satisfy).

**Attribution.** Pure omission → scope-of-work → `caused_by f449-be6a-be56-4fef` (`git log -S refresh_scoped_snapshot`: the call was added by 3b92fad "Refresh scoped keys before diff (bug f449)" with no offline coverage). Close class `plan_defect`.

**RED→GREEN test.** `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_run_differs_wires_refresh_scoped_snapshot_79a4.py` (2 tests). Spies `refresh_scoped_snapshot` at its SOURCE module (rename/move-robust — `run_differs` re-resolves the local import at call time). Proven under `sandbox-exec` (no `timeout` binary on host): call deleted → spy records 0 calls, both tests RED (mutation kill); call present → GREEN. The 13 existing behaviour tests in `test_scoped_snapshot_overlay_f449.py` are untouched and still pass (AC4 retained). Mutation-check IS the core proof.

**Siblings (Step 7 sweep).** `refresh_scoped_snapshot` has exactly ONE production caller (now covered). `overlay_lagfree_scalars` is only called internally by it (covered). No parity/parallel surfaces. Nothing to fix or ticket.

**Non-test change.** Docstring-only ADR-citation fix in `snapshot_lagfree_refresh.py` (ADR 0037 → ADR 0055 search-index-lag row); +2/-1 lines, far under the 150-line bugfix-size floor → no review-plan attestation required. `make lint` + `make typecheck` clean; 15 targeted tests pass.

**Land.** Gerrit change **2394**: LLM-Review +1 (1 non-blocking advisory — accepted, see below), Verified +1, 0 unresolved. Self-submitted → **MERGED as db6559687ef8** (ancestor of origin/main).

**Close.** Completion-verifier gate ran and **signed** (`signed: true`). Routed the close via the local worktree CLI (fallback for the local-code referencing-commit precheck) because the MCP server's `mcp-code` checkout had not yet advanced to see the freshly-merged commit; the worktree HEAD (3bf2fed, `rebar-ticket:` trailer) is directly reachable. No `--force` used anywhere.

**Accepted residual.** LLM-Review advisory: the offline harness leaves the ticket_planner shadow layer unstubbed. Intentional — it runs pure over an empty pass and mirrors the sibling harness `test_snapshot_differ_stale_local_state.py`. Non-blocking.
